name: Hills count
description: Naismith's rule: about one extra hour per 600 m climbed (6 s per metre).

name: Wheelchair
description: No stairs; climbs, steep grades and rough surfaces cost a lot; raised kerbs, roads without sidewalks and icy slopes are avoided where the data knows them.

name: Stroller
description: Stairs possible but painful; rough and steep paths avoided.

name: Shady
description: Each sunny metre costs as much as a second of walking.

name: Lit at night
description: Unlit streets after dark cost double.

name: Bike
description: Cycling time plus hills, traffic stress and rough surfaces.

name: Icy day
description: Winter: shady slopes stay icy, so avoid steep ground the sun does not reach.

name: Peaceful
description: Quiet streets with greenery or water; busy roads and bare stretches cost extra.

name: Flood-safe
description: Stay out of FEMA flood zones (Princeton flooded in Ida, 2021).

name: Few crossings
description: Fewer street crossings, unsignalled ones most of all (older walkers, kids, bikes).
